verdicts.reason: The two leaderboards are almost the same and both are broken. Six columns are packed into 90px, and the body copy and legal text are too small to read. 'Ships late June' wraps into a 3-word vertical stack, the legal block is squeezed into a narrow column next to the CTA, and the small CTA competes with a 4-line headline wall. The eyebrow sits stranded under the logo panel. A's sun mark is slightly larger and easier to see than B's tiny, blurry logo, so A is marginally better.
